description: Marion, IA — A new Fox News story exposed Josh Turek for accepting more than $20,000 in taxpayer-funded per diem benefits while skipping 58% of votes in the 2026 legislative session. Turek even skipped the vote to fund the Iowa Department of Veterans Affairs to attend a fundraiser with a Schumer-aligned Super PAC. Hinson has a 98.8% lifetime voting record since her election to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2020. Every Iowa reporter should ask Turek why he took per diem when he skipped 58% of votes in the 2026 legislative session. Why should he get a promotion when he isn’t showing up for work? “Josh Turek took more than $20,000 in per diem funded by Iowa taxpayers without showing up for work,” said Hinson Campaign Communications Director Billy Fuerst. “He skipped 58% of votes this year, including on investments in rural healthcare and the Iowa Farm Bill, and even skipped a vote to fund the Iowa Department of Veterans Affairs to fundraise with a Schumer Super PAC. Turek should have to answer for his absentee legislating while taking taxpayer-funded per diem. Iowans deserve better.” Some of the most egregious votes that Turek skipped include: ###
